decision_conditions:
- An existing and proposed elevation drawing is required in accordance with the validation checklist requirements (local requirements). This should be to a specified scale and not a photograph. 
	- The Heritage Statement requires further information on the proposed location for the boiler. It states the side room is not part of the original building, however more information is required regarding the history of listed building, for example when this addition was built and its significance. It is recommended the guidance available on the Richmond Council website for preparation of a Heritage Statement is consulted heritage_statements.pdf
	- The submitted Method Statement contains insufficient information. For example it does not provide information on how the boiler will be installed, how will it be fixed, how will the flue be installed all to minimise the impact on historic fabric. 
	- The summitted plan 'End Elevation Drawing' does not include a scale bar. 
	- A new location plan is required. The red line has currently only been drawn around the dwelling not the site. 
It is recommended the following application is consulted for guidance on required documentation levels: 20/1662/LBC
